Background

Gallego is a Marine Corps veteran who served in the U.S. House from 2015 to 2025 and was elected to the Senate in 2024. He has emphasized working-class voters, including Latino men.

Outlook

Down one point. Gallego said in Denver that his three young children will weigh heavily on his decision and that he would have to work out how to run without personal wealth. His October economic plan was read as groundwork for a campaign, but he starts from a low base nationally, under 1 percent in prediction markets, and shares a home state with Kelly.
